blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Workers in Cebu who report for duty on All Saints’ Day and All Souls’ Day can earn 30 percent more than their basic daily wage, while those who work on Bonifacio Day later in November can receive double pay under the Department of Labor and Employment’s (Dole) holiday pay rules.
